'''Raygus Mol''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]], infamous for the burning of [[New Drev'starn]]. At some point he became part of the [[Order of Revan]] and defected from the Empire, joining with the Revanite forces on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi's]] [[Sky Ridge Island]] under command of Lord [[Ivress]]. However, a fellow Revanite from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Edrinu Zaya]] became disillusioned with the new cause after realizing that the Revanites accepted the Empire's worst butchers. She asked a Republic agent infiltrating their camp to kill Imperial colonel Mol, a mission that was successfully accomplished.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Colonel Raygus Mol appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].
